features.name: nearest_fire_dist_km
features.null_rule: never null; 9999.0 when no fire in the window
features.training_definition: distance to the closest of the detections with issue_time - 72 h <= detected_at < issue_time, within 200 km (haversine) of the forecast point
features.live_definition: identical; source fire_detections, satellite = 'VIIRS_SNPP' (live rows come from VIIRS_SNPP_NRT, normalised to the same tag)

features.name: fire_bearing_sin
features.null_rule: never null; 0.0 when no fire in the window
features.training_definition: sin of the initial bearing (deg from north) point -> nearest fire
features.live_definition: identical

features.name: fire_bearing_cos
features.null_rule: never null; 0.0 when no fire in the window
features.training_definition: cos of the initial bearing (deg from north) point -> nearest fire
features.live_definition: identical

features.name: total_frp_200km
features.null_rule: never null; 0.0 when no fire in the window
features.training_definition: sum over the detections with issue_time - 72 h <= detected_at < issue_time, within 200 km (haversine) of the forecast point of frp_mw (null frp = 0) x (1 - distance_km / 200)
features.live_definition: identical

features.name: active_fire_count_200km
features.null_rule: never null; 0 when no fire in the window
features.training_definition: number of detections with issue_time - 72 h <= detected_at < issue_time, within 200 km (haversine) of the forecast point
features.live_definition: identical

features.name: wind_alignment
features.null_rule: null when wind direction or fire bearing is null
features.training_definition: cos(fire_bearing_deg - wind_dir_deg); weather_observations (NCEI Global Hourly, ingestion/connectors/ncei.py); nearest weather station to the point (fixed per point); latest report with issue_time - 3 h <= valid_at <= issue_time
features.live_definition: identical formula; weather_observations (NWS station observations, DATA-06); nearest weather station to the point (fixed per point); latest report with issue_time - 3 h <= valid_at <= issue_time; same station ids (ICAO)

features.name: wind_speed_ms
features.null_rule: null when no report in the 3 h window
features.training_definition: wind speed of the selected report; weather_observations (NCEI Global Hourly, ingestion/connectors/ncei.py); nearest weather station to the point (fixed per point); latest report with issue_time - 3 h <= valid_at <= issue_time
features.live_definition: NWS windSpeed, converted to m/s from its unitCode (wmoUnit:km_h-1 divides by 3.6); weather_observations (NWS station observations, DATA-06); nearest weather station to the point (fixed per point); latest report with issue_time - 3 h <= valid_at <= issue_time; same station ids (ICAO)

features.name: wind_dir_sin
features.null_rule: null when direction is null (calm wind, speed 0, has no direction)
features.training_definition: sin(wind_dir_deg), direction the wind blows FROM
features.live_definition: identical; NWS windDirection; set direction null whenever wind_speed_ms == 0, as NCEI does for calm

features.name: wind_dir_cos
features.null_rule: null when direction is null (calm wind)
features.training_definition: cos(wind_dir_deg)
features.live_definition: identical; same calm rule

features.name: temp_c
features.null_rule: null when no report in the 3 h window
features.training_definition: air temperature; weather_observations (NCEI Global Hourly, ingestion/connectors/ncei.py); nearest weather station to the point (fixed per point); latest report with issue_time - 3 h <= valid_at <= issue_time
features.live_definition: NWS temperature (degC); weather_observations (NWS station observations, DATA-06); nearest weather station to the point (fixed per point); latest report with issue_time - 3 h <= valid_at <= issue_time; same station ids (ICAO)

features.name: rh_pct
features.null_rule: null when temperature or dew point is null
features.training_definition: relative_humidity_from_dewpoint(temp_c, dewpoint_c) in ingestion/normalize.py
features.live_definition: same function applied to NWS temperature and dewpoint; do not use NWS relativeHumidity

features.name: pressure_hpa
features.null_rule: null when the report has no sea-level pressure (~54% of training rows)
features.training_definition: sea-level pressure (ISD SLP); null if <= 800
features.live_definition: NWS seaLevelPressure / 100 (Pa -> hPa); never barometricPressure (station pressure); null if missing or <= 800

features.name: precip_1h_mm
features.null_rule: null when the report has no 1 h accumulation (~59% of training rows); null is not 0
features.training_definition: ISD AA1-AA4 1 h accumulation
features.live_definition: NWS precipitationLastHour in mm; keep null as null

features.name: pm25_lag_1h
features.null_rule: null when the monitor has no reading at that hour
features.training_definition: AirNow regulatory RawConcentration at the point's own monitor, observation valid_at exactly issue_time - 1 h (time offsets applied at ingest, values in [-5, 0) clamped to 0); null if no such hour
features.live_definition: same query against observations (correction = 'regulatory'); for a grid cell there is no monitor, so grid cells are never fed to the model (Stage B interpolates forecasts, not features)

features.name: pm25_lag_3h
features.null_rule: null when the monitor has no reading at that hour
features.training_definition: AirNow regulatory RawConcentration at the point's own monitor, observation valid_at exactly issue_time - 3 h (time offsets applied at ingest, values in [-5, 0) clamped to 0); null if no such hour
features.live_definition: identical to pm25_lag_1h

features.name: pm25_lag_6h
features.null_rule: null when the monitor has no reading at that hour
features.training_definition: AirNow regulatory RawConcentration at the point's own monitor, observation valid_at exactly issue_time - 6 h (time offsets applied at ingest, values in [-5, 0) clamped to 0); null if no such hour
features.live_definition: identical to pm25_lag_1h

features.name: pm25_lag_12h
features.null_rule: null when the monitor has no reading at that hour
features.training_definition: AirNow regulatory RawConcentration at the point's own monitor, observation valid_at exactly issue_time - 12 h (time offsets applied at ingest, values in [-5, 0) clamped to 0); null if no such hour
features.live_definition: identical to pm25_lag_1h

features.name: pm25_lag_24h
features.null_rule: null when the monitor has no reading at that hour
features.training_definition: AirNow regulatory RawConcentration at the point's own monitor, observation valid_at exactly issue_time - 24 h (time offsets applied at ingest, values in [-5, 0) clamped to 0); null if no such hour
features.live_definition: identical to pm25_lag_1h

features.name: day_of_year
features.null_rule: never null
features.training_definition: issue_time (UTC) day of year
features.live_definition: identical

features.name: month
features.null_rule: never null
features.training_definition: issue_time (UTC) month
features.live_definition: identical

features.name: smoke_season
features.null_rule: never null
features.training_definition: month in 6..10 (June to October)
features.live_definition: identical

features.name: local_solar_hour
features.null_rule: never null
features.training_definition: (UTC hour + minute / 60 + second / 3600 + longitude / 15) mod 24, longitude of the forecast point
features.live_definition: identical, using the monitor's longitude

features.name: horizon_hours
features.null_rule: never null
features.training_definition: one of [1, 3, 6, 12, 24]; set by the caller per model
features.live_definition: predict_v2.predict sets it from its horizon argument; do not supply it

features.name: persistence
features.null_rule: null only when lag_1h, lag_3h and lag_6h are all null
features.training_definition: ml.features.persistence: lag_1h, else lag_3h, else lag_6h
features.live_definition: derived by add_derived; do not supply

features.name: trend_1_3
features.null_rule: null when lag_1h or lag_3h is null
features.training_definition: pm25_lag_1h - pm25_lag_3h
features.live_definition: derived by add_derived; do not supply

features.name: trend_1_6
features.null_rule: null when lag_1h or lag_6h is null
features.training_definition: pm25_lag_1h - pm25_lag_6h
features.live_definition: derived by add_derived; do not supply

features.name: ratio_1_24
features.null_rule: null when lag_1h or lag_24h is null
features.live_definition: derived by add_derived; do not supply

excluded.location_lat: site position; would memorise sites across events
excluded.location_lon: site position; would memorise sites across events
excluded.event_tier: derived from the labels (max in-box peak)
excluded.precip_prob_pct: always null (observed weather has no probability)
excluded.issue_time: timestamp; calendar features carry its signal
